note: Tied to real #142 branches, not arbitrary percentage. No branch forced absent its predicate. If more than one discriminator actionable, complete via Director after result, no endclaim.

PROMOTE_positive.description: Positive promotion to deploy/candidate PASS. Demands all three jointly.
PROMOTE_positive.independent_replication: Strict wrong-owner reduction vs none on fixed 8-window matched cohort, definite AND pessimistic (cannot gain by excluding words), on >=2 new source sessions INCLUDING cohort-diverse NP3, with H or latched arm silent where original suppressed. Historical P4/salvage never counted.
PROMOTE_positive.no_new_severe_guard: Zero newly confident wrong-owner content words (>=1 content word) on any supported singleton span vs original; no new in-span segmentation harm introduced by latch beyond original uncertainty. Proxies semantic-only, reported separate.
PROMOTE_positive.legal_charged_timing: Every applied applicable boundary charges measured flush wall of emit (max confirmation/frontier) against same-expiry seal; max_permissible_lag >=0 (not too_late even at zero lag). UNKNOWN lag stays UNKNOWN, never causal PASS on lower bound alone. Out-of-payload flush UNKNOWN cannot satisfy.

P3T_conversion.description: P3-T research branch on conversion failure. Justified by mechanism falsification, cannot call deploy/candidate PASS with unknowns.
P3T_conversion.useful_observed_evidence: At least one timed case shows strict definite+pessimistic reduction vs none with latched boundary inside payload and legal charged timing (conditional).
P3T_conversion.conversion_failure: Demonstrated downstream conversion failure where correct boundary cannot convert to applied receipt (e.g. too_late at zero lag, invalid_scope pre-payload consuming the only original fire, or flat-tail no-fire at any nonnegative L).
P3T_conversion.causal_assumptions_explicit: All UNKNOWN lags, flush unknowns, and headroom limits stated; no zero-credit.
P3T_conversion.note: Cannot ignore wrong-run (false-moved left, fragmentation) or safety fail (severe guard, mixed unknown exposure).

P3R_reference.description: P3-R research branch on reference deficit.
P3R_reference.specific_reference_deficit: Named reference-generation deficit demonstrated on GT (e.g. ref-A-absent/B+C-observed with zero A/D words+segments, or anchor mismatch blocking assignment), not arbitrary no-event. Must cite episode, interval, word IDs, segment hrefs, mapping_records anchor.

P3O_observation_first.control_useful: Correct-transition control (b unchanged +100ms support only) shows strict definite+pessimistic reduction vs none on at least one timed case, proving downstream headroom conditional.
P3O_observation_first.indistinguishable_states: Current evidence (orig+alt) cannot distinguish demonstrated states (e.g. same fire, same ownership, or provider-timestamp-bounded headroom) on the discriminating cohort.
P3O_observation_first.note: Cannot claim new encoder from indistinguishable states.

BOUNDED_AUDIO.description: Bounded Audio decision on post-seal help.
BOUNDED_AUDIO.known_lateness: Demonstrated known lateness (measured flush past seal, negative max_permissible_lag) where post-seal help could still apply. UNKNOWN flush/lag never qualifies.

STOP.description: Stop only a named tested policy/target where controlled evidence actually rejects.
STOP.named_tested_policy: Names exact policy/target tested (e.g. original single-fire on NP1 episode, F0/H tau, 1600 confirmation).
STOP.controlled_rejection: Controlled evidence (same b/charged availability, same GT cohort, same seal) rejects it: e.g. suppressed true second transition with applicable legal timing, or flat-tail no-fire proving speed alone insufficient.

evaluation_rule: Do not force one allowed branch absent its predicate. Evaluate each branch predicate independently on ledger. If zero branches meet predicates => GATE BLOCKED, report missing discriminator. If more than one discriminator actionable => report exact changed decision needed via Director after result, no endclaim. Research branch can be justified by mechanism falsification but cannot be called deploy/candidate PASS with unknowns.
provenance_barrier: Preliminary evaluation records provenance PENDING. Final branch claim only after Director barrier message consumes provenance/RESULT.json.
